title: Hoodoo Scarecrow
description: A tattered scarecrow stands against a dark, smoky background. It is adorned with occult items including a horseshoe, lantern, tarot card, coins, and a stitched X-eyed face, with a carved wooden horse head mounted on a post at its base.
prompt: A sinister scarecrow figure stands in the center of the frame wearing a tattered black cloak and pointed hat, its burlap face has stitched X eyes and a grim smile, straw hands outstretched holding a gold coin and a dollar bill, body decorated with a horseshoe necklace, hanging lantern, purple tarot card, and various charms, a carved wooden horse head with black mane is mounted on a post at its waist, dramatic dark blue and brown smoky background with worn distressed edges, moody occult atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
